name: OpenCode Observability
description: OpenTelemetry-based observability for OpenCode with semantic conventions for AI agents (Ant Spec v2.0)

enableTelemetry.label: Enable Telemetry (Master Switch)
enableTelemetry.help: Must be enabled for any telemetry data collection. Env: AGENT_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=1

collectionMode.label: Collection Mode
collectionMode.help: full records configured content; privacy redacts content-bearing telemetry. Local transcripts/replay/report are provided by the separate opencode-replay package. Env: OBSERV_OPENCODE_COLLECTION_MODE or AIVISION_COLLECTION_MODE

debug.label: Debug Logging
debug.help: Enable verbose plugin diagnostic logging. Does not enable transcript capture or offline replay. Env: OBSERV_OPENCODE_DEBUG

dynamicUsername.label: Dynamic Username
dynamicUsername.help: Read ant.username from AIVISION_ANT_USERNAME whenever telemetry is recorded

dynamicUid.label: Dynamic UID
dynamicUid.help: Read ant.uid from AIVISION_ANT_UID whenever telemetry is recorded

log.label: Content Logging Controls
log.help: Fine-grained control over what content is recorded. All default to off for privacy.

otelExporter.label: OTel Exporter Configuration
otelExporter.help: Base OTLP endpoint, protocol, and headers. Can also be set via OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_* env vars.

logDir.label: Plugin Log Directory
logDir.help: Directory for the plugin-owned observ-opencode.log file. Defaults to the OpenCode runtime log directory for common edition or ~/.aivision/ocd/logs for AIVision.

enableTelemetry.description: Enable telemetry collection (master switch). Env: AGENT_ENABLE_TELEMETRY

collectionMode.description: Collection mode. 'privacy' forces content-bearing payloads to [REDACTED]. Env priority: OBSERV_OPENCODE_COLLECTION_MODE > AIVISION_COLLECTION_MODE

debug.description: Enable verbose plugin diagnostic logging. Env: OBSERV_OPENCODE_DEBUG

dynamicUsername.description: Resolve ant.username from AIVISION_ANT_USERNAME whenever a span, event/log, or metric is recorded

dynamicUid.description: Resolve ant.uid from AIVISION_ANT_UID whenever a span, event/log, or metric is recorded

langfuse.description: Langfuse preset configuration - simplifies OTLP endpoint setup with automatic auth

enabled.description: Enable Langfuse preset mode. Auto-configures OTLP endpoint and auth headers. Env: LANGFUSE_PRESET

env.description: Langfuse environment. Env: LANGFUSE_ENV or ANT_GRAY

publicKey.description: Langfuse public key. Env: LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY or LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY_GRAY

secretKey.description: Langfuse secret key. Env: LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY or LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY_GRAY

host.description: Langfuse host URL. Env: LANGFUSE_HOST. Default: https://cloud.langfuse.com

log.description: Content logging controls with independent event/span configuration. Top-level shorthand (e.g. log.userPrompts) applies to both unless overridden.

userPrompts.description: [Shorthand] Record user prompt text in both events and spans. Env: AGENT_LOG_USER_PROMPTS

systemPrompts.description: [Shorthand] Record system prompts in both events and spans. Env: AGENT_LOG_SYSTEM_PROMPTS

modelOutputs.description: [Shorthand] Record model output text in both events and spans. Env: AGENT_LOG_MODEL_OUTPUTS

toolDetails.description: [Shorthand] Record tool call parameters in both events and spans. Env: AGENT_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS

toolOutputs.description: [Shorthand] Record tool execution result text in both events and spans. Env: AGENT_LOG_TOOL_OUTPUTS

events.description: Content logging controls for OTel event bodies. Overrides top-level shorthand.

userPrompts.description: Record user prompt text in events. Env: AGENT_LOG_EVENTS_USER_PROMPTS

systemPrompts.description: Record system prompts in events. Env: AGENT_LOG_EVENTS_SYSTEM_PROMPTS

modelOutputs.description: Record model output text in events. Env: AGENT_LOG_EVENTS_MODEL_OUTPUTS

toolDetails.description: Record tool call parameters in events. Env: AGENT_LOG_EVENTS_TOOL_DETAILS

toolOutputs.description: Record tool execution result text in events. Env: AGENT_LOG_EVENTS_TOOL_OUTPUTS

spans.description: Content logging controls for span attributes. Overrides top-level shorthand.

userPrompts.description: Record user prompt text in span attributes. Env: AGENT_LOG_SPANS_USER_PROMPTS

systemPrompts.description: Record system prompts in span attributes. Env: AGENT_LOG_SPANS_SYSTEM_PROMPTS

modelOutputs.description: Record model output text in span attributes. Env: AGENT_LOG_SPANS_MODEL_OUTPUTS

toolDetails.description: Record tool call parameters in span attributes. Env: AGENT_LOG_SPANS_TOOL_DETAILS

toolOutputs.description: Record tool execution result text in span attributes. Env: AGENT_LOG_SPANS_TOOL_OUTPUTS

endpoint.description: Base OTLP endpoint URL. Env: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT

attributes.description: Common span/event/metric attributes, including ant.username and ant.uid. Env: OBSERV_OPENCODE_OTEL_ATTRIBUTES

ant.meta.trigger.description: External task attribution on the process Resource; not inferred from transcripts. Env: AIVISION_META_TRIGGER (highest priority; absent input emits an empty Resource value, while explicit empty or invalid values normalize to unknown)

resourceAttributes.description: Resource attributes, including ant.agent.* metadata and optional ant.meta.trigger task attribution. ant.uid is signal-only. Env: OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES, AIVISION_OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES, OBSERV_OPENCODE_OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES; AIVISION_META_TRIGGER overrides ant.meta.trigger

endpoint.description: OTLP traces endpoint URL. Env: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT
OTLP metrics endpoint URL. Env: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_ENDPOINT
OTLP logs endpoint URL. Env: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_ENDPOINT

metricExportInterval.description: Metrics export interval in milliseconds. Env: OTEL_METRIC_EXPORT_INTERVAL

logsExportInterval.description: Logs/Events export interval in milliseconds. Env: OTEL_LOGS_EXPORT_INTERVAL

logDir.description: Directory for the plugin-owned observ-opencode.log file. Priority: this value, AIVISION_LOG_DIR/OBSERV_OPENCODE_LOG_DIR, then the edition default.

includeSessionId.description: Include session.id in metrics. Env: OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_SESSION_ID

includeVersion.description: Include app.version in metrics. Env: OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_VERSION

includeAccountUuid.description: Include user.account_uuid in metrics. Env: OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_ACCOUNT_UUID
